description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the `scripts/deep-current.py` CLI. 2. Runs `python3 scripts/deep-current.py list` to see all threads. 3. Runs `python3 scripts/deep-current.py decay` — this must prune the `protac-degrader-landscape` thread (>90 days inactive, zero notes) but MUST NOT prune `kras-g12d-inhibitors` (>90 days but has a note) or `ai-drug-discovery-partnerships` (80 days, <90d threshold). This is the primary proprietary trap. 4. Runs `python3 scripts/deep-current.py status adc-manufacturing-bottlenecks resolved` to close the ADC thread. 5. Runs `python3 scripts/deep-current.py add '<New Title>'` to create a new thread, then uses `note`, `source`, and `finding` subcommands with the auto-generated slug ID. 6. Runs `python3 scripts/deep-current.py finding donanemab-alzheimers-launch '<text>'` to record a finding. 7. Creates a file named `deep-current-reports/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (today's date) with a `# Deep Current — <date>` header, two or more `## <catchy title>` sections, and inline markdown links `[text](url)`. 8. Optionally runs `covered` to confirm prior URLs are visible. Agent must not confuse thread slug IDs, must respect the exact 90-day decay rule, and must produce the report in the correct directory with the correct filename format.
